claim: Lemma 1, properness without an upper-tail moment
assumptions: Iid finite positive edge weights; simple paths have distinct edges; lattice degree four.
reason: The 4*3^(n-1) path count and 2^n p^(n/2) subset bound give (4/3)(6sqrt(p))^n. With p<1/144 this is summable. Borel-Cantelli is applied per vertex, then countably across vertices; no independence across paths or lengths is needed.
independent_derivation: ATTEMPT.md; direct counting and deterministic finite-modification argument.
remaining_gap: No bound on large-shell anchoring is supplied by properness.

claim: Lemma 3 and Proposition 4, monotone capacity and conditional probability
assumptions: e strictly inside shells from some n0 onward; outside properness; independent atomless positive t_e; H_n and H_infinity depend only on outside weights.
reason: Truncating strict e-using witnesses proves H_(n+1)<=H_n. Countable fixed-edge diagonal compactness yields the exact two-sided witness equivalence. Independence removes ties t_e=H_n or H_infinity, then conditional probability integrates a single edge and equals F(H_infinity).
